import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
acct = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
before = acct[acct.date<'2025-10-20']
after = acct[(acct.date>='2025-10-20')&(acct.date<='2025-10-30')]
def agg(d):
    return d.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(b=('unblended_cost','sum'), n=('date','nunique'))
b = agg(before); b['b_daily']=b.b/b.n
a = agg(after); a['a_daily']=a.b/a.n
# also check combos existing only in one period
print(set(zip(a.index.get_level_values(0),a.index.get_level_values(1),a.index.get_level_values(2))) - set(b.index))

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')

a = after.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].agg(['sum','count'])

comb['bd']=comb['sum_b']/49; comb['ad']=comb['sum_a']/11
comb['delta']=comb['ad']-comb['bd']
print(comb.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(15))
